title: Turtle holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#3cb371'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7fd8a0'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='55' r='3' fill='#7fd8a0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='55' r='3' fill='#7fd8a0'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='63' r='3' fill='#7fd8a0'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M76 62 Q80 65 84 62' stroke='#4f7a2a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arm reaching up to string -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q76 52 62 44' stroke='#8fbc5a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hand -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#a5cf72'/>
